title: Discover Central Vietnam
headline: Da Nang, the Golden Bridge and lantern-lit Hoi An.
description: A four-day family holiday through Central Vietnam: beaches and cable cars in Da Nang, Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge, then a day in Hoi An’s ancient town.
image_alt: Lantern-lined street in Hoi An Ancient Town at dusk
price_guidance: Indicative from twin sharing, excluding international flights and visa fees. Your written quote itemises stays, transfers and selected tours for your dates.
overview: A compact family holiday through Central Vietnam. Arrive in Da Nang for seafronts and a modern city rhythm, ride to Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge, then spend a day among Hoi An’s lanterns, temples and riverside streets. The pace leaves room for beaches, Fantasy Park and evenings together.
highlights: Walk Hoi An Ancient Town among centuries-old Vietnamese, Chinese and Japanese architecture.
See Da Nang from the Golden Bridge, 1,400 metres above the plains.
Ride Asia’s modern cable car for a view of the port city and coastline.
Share Fantasy Park rides and attractions as a family.
why: Culture, viewpoints and family entertainment in one short itinerary.
A single stay in Da Nang keeps packing light for children.
Evenings free for the beach or a quiet dinner.
inclusions: Airport transfers in a private vehicle
Hoi An day tour from Da Nang, including the Thu Bon River, on a shared basis
Ba Na Hills and Golden Bridge day tour on a shared basis
